nodes.name: Fetch Q&A Thread
nodes.notes: Bind Google Chat API OAuth. Keep the thread read bounded to the latest 20 messages.

nodes.name: Call '[PILOT] Private Modus Context Resolver'
nodes.notes: Resolver-first evidence boundary. Keep this node on the main path before the Q&A Agent.

parameters.text:
=Return only valid JSON.

Question and thread context:
{{ JSON.stringify($('Normalize Q&A Event').item.json) }}

Authoritative repository evidence from the Context Resolver:
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

Return this shape:
{"answer":"string","confidence":"high|medium|low","evidence":[{"claim":"string","source":"string"}],"status":"answered|needs_clarification|work_implied|not_found","followUpQuestion":null,"issueDraft":null}

Rules:
- The resolver payload above is the only authority for component capabilities.
- Do not use internet knowledge, model memory, older Modus versions, or aliases.
- Use only component tags and properties present in resolver.matches.
- If resolver.matches is empty, return status not_found and say the capability is not verified.
- Never substitute modus-text-input for modus-wc-text-input.
- Cite repository, manifest, commit, and declaration source for every capability claim.
- Answer first. Do not create an issue for a question.
- Use work_implied only when a concrete repository/design change is justified by the answer.
- For work_implied, include a complete draft with title, summary, type, components, labels, acceptanceCriteria, and designNeeded.
- If source is missing, disclose the gap rather than guessing.

options.systemMessage: You are the Modus shared-context Q&A bot. Your primary job is accurate, cited answers. The Context Resolver payload is the authoritative evidence boundary. Issue creation is an explicit secondary escalation only after human confirmation.

nodes.name: Trimble Model Gateway
nodes.notes: Bind Trimble Identity after import. No credential is stored in this template.

nodes.name: Call Shared Issue Service
nodes.notes: The shared service performs duplicate search and calls Issue Scaffolding with autoApprove false.

parameters.jsCode:
const issueUrl = $json.issueUrl ?? $json.url ?? $json.issue?.html_url ?? null;
return [{ json: { chatResponse: { text: issueUrl ? `I created a draft request for Issue Scaffolding: ${issueUrl}` : 'The request was accepted by the shared service. A human should inspect the n8n execution for the draft URL before retrying.' } } }];
